title: Architecture overview
alt: Boxes and arrows: the web shop and the app reach summit through the edge; summit uses PostgreSQL and cairn; porter talks to the warehouse and the mail relay; Paygrove sends webhooks.

title: Checkout sequence
alt: Sequence diagram of a payment between the customer, the web shop, summit and Paygrove, ending with the payment webhook.

title: Stock sync with its guard
alt: Flow from the warehouse's stock file through porter and a new guard into PostgreSQL and cairn; a failed guard stops the sync and pages on-call.

title: Core data model
alt: Entity diagram of products, variants, stock levels, customers, orders and order lines with their relations.

title: Deploy pipeline
alt: Seven steps from a merge to production: test, build, staging, smoke tests, a canary at 10 percent, then everyone.

title: Incident response
alt: Flowchart: an alert, acknowledgement, a decision whether customers are affected, then an incident with updates and a fix, and a postmortem.

title: Search indexing
alt: summit writes changes to an outbox; the cairn indexer reads it and updates the index that the shop and the app query.

title: App release train
alt: A two-week timeline: features on main, branch cut and beta, store review, then a staged rollout.

title: Team map
alt: Six pixel avatars grouped into product, engineering, and quality and support, with names and roles.

title: Roadmap board
alt: Three columns, now, next and later, with the projects planned in each.

title: Checkout conversion chart
alt: Bar chart of weekly checkout conversion: the three-step checkout stays near 2.8 percent, the one-page checkout climbs from 3.1 to 3.6 percent.

title: API latency chart
alt: Line chart of p50 and p95 latency over 30 days, with a spike during the stock sync incident and a drop after search moved to cairn.

title: Crash-free sessions chart
alt: Bar chart of crash-free sessions per app version; the first 3.0 beta dips to 98.2 percent.

title: Return reasons chart
alt: Horizontal bars of return reasons; too small and too big together cause more than half of all returns.
